units.locator: Article 19.7. Failure to provide data (information)
units.text: Failure to provide, or late provision to a state body (official), a body (official) exercising state control (supervision) or state financial control, an organisation authorised under federal laws to exercise state supervision (its official), or a body (official) exercising municipal control or municipal financial control, of data (information) whose provision is required by law and is necessary for the lawful activities of that body (official), or provision to a state body (official), a body (official) exercising state control (supervision) or state financial control, an organisation authorised under federal laws to exercise state supervision (its official), or a body (official) exercising municipal control or municipal financial control, of such data (information) in incomplete or distorted form, except in the cases provided for by Article 6.16, part 2 of Article 6.31, parts 1, 2, 4, 10 and 11 of Article 8.28.1, Article 8.32.1, part 1 of Article 8.49, part 5 of Article 14.5, part 4 of Article 14.28, part 1 of Article 14.46.2, part 2 of Article 14.57, Articles 19.4.3, 19.7.1, 19.7.2, 19.7.3, 19.7.5, 19.7.5-1, 19.7.7, 19.7.8, 19.7.9, 19.7.12 - 19.7.16, 19.8 and 19.8.3, and parts 2, 7, 8 and 9 of Article 19.34 of this Code —
units.label: Art. 19.7 · “Failure to provide, or late provision to a state body…”

units.locator: Article 19.7. Failure to provide data (information)
units.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred to three hundred roubles; on officials, three hundred to five hundred roubles; on legal entities, three thousand to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Art. 19.7 · “entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine…”

units.locator: Article 19.7.3. Failure to provide information to the Bank of Russia
units.text: 1. Failure to submit, or violation of the procedure or deadlines for submitting to the Bank of Russia, reports, notifications and other information required by legislation and (or) necessary for the lawful activities of that body (official), or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information, except where, under insurance legislation or the legislation of the Russian Federation on credit cooperation, agricultural cooperation, microfinance activities and microfinance organisations, or pawnshops, the Bank of Russia issues a lawful compliance order to remedy a violation of insurance legislation or the legislation of the Russian Federation on credit cooperation, agricultural cooperation, microfinance activities and microfinance organisations, or pawnshops, and except in the cases specified in part 2 of this Article, if these actions (inaction) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.7.3

units.locator: Article 19.7.3. Failure to provide information to the Bank of Russia
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.7.3 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of…”

units.locator: Article 19.7.3. Failure to provide information to the Bank of Russia
units.text: 2. Failure by a credit consumer cooperative whose total membership does not exceed three thousand individuals and (or) legal entities and whose assets do not exceed the value determined by a normative act of the Bank of Russia in accordance with the legislation on credit cooperation, an agricultural credit consumer cooperative whose total membership and associate membership do not exceed three thousand individuals and (or) legal entities and whose assets do not exceed the value determined by a normative act of the Bank of Russia in accordance with the legislation on agricultural cooperation, or a housing savings cooperative, to submit, or violation of the procedure or deadlines for submitting to the Bank of Russia, reports, notifications and other information required by legislation and (or) necessary for the lawful activities of that body (official), or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information, except where, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on credit cooperation, agricultural cooperation or housing savings cooperatives, the Bank of Russia, in supervising their activities, issues a lawful compliance order to remedy a violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation by a credit consumer cooperative whose total membership does not exceed three thousand individuals and (or) legal entities and whose assets do not exceed the value determined by a normative act of the Bank of Russia in accordance with the legislation on credit cooperation, an agricultural credit consumer cooperative whose total membership and associate membership do not exceed three thousand individuals and (or) legal entities and whose assets do not exceed the value determined by a normative act of the Bank of Russia in accordance with the legislation on agricultural cooperation, or a housing savings cooperative, if these actions (inaction) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.7.3

units.locator: Article 19.7.3. Failure to provide information to the Bank of Russia
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
